__
 
• Interest received on loans is not a capital receipt.

• **Revenue receipts** are inflows of funds that result in an increase in the **income **of a business or organization.

• **Revenue receipts**, on the other hand, are typically generated from the ongoing operations of a business and are used to fund the **day-to-day expenses** of the business, such as salaries, rent, and utilities. Examples of revenue receipts include sales of goods or services, rent or lease payments, and interest income.

questions.question: Which one of the following is not a part of the Local Government in India?
questions.solution:
__**Development Authority**__ is NOT correct.

__
 
• **Development Authority is not a part of the Local Government in India**__.
 
• **Development Authority** means a person or body appointed as a Development Authority as contemplated by and in accordance with the Municipal Government Act.
 __
 
• It was envisaged that the development authorities would help in planning, implementing and coordinating development activities in a structured manner.
 
• The actual implementation of urban projects and master plans has started after the formation of the Urban Development Authorities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Local government** in India refers to the government jurisdiction below the state level.

 
 
• A uniform three-tier structure of
 
 
• panchayats at village (Gram Panchayat - GP),
 
• intermediate or block (Panchayat Samiti - PS) and
 
• district (Zilla Parishad - ZP) levels.
 
 
 
• All the seats in the Panchayat at each level are to be filled by election from the respective regional constituencies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is a federal republic with three regions of government: central, state and local.
 
 
• The 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendments provide recognition and protection to local governments and in addition, each state has its own local government legislation.
 
• Since 1992, local government in India takes place in two different forms.
 
• Urban areas covered by the 74th Amendment to the Constitution have municipalities, but they derive their powers from individual state governments, while the powers of rural areas have been formalized under the Panchayati Raj system under the 73rd Amendment to the Constitution.

⇒ x² + 10 = 7x 

⇒ x² - 7x + 10 = 0

⇒ x² - 5x - 2x + 10 = 0

⇒ x(x - 5) - 2(x - 5) = 0

⇒ x = 5 and 2

questions.question: What is the difference between the molecular masses of two successive members of the homologous series?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__14 u.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• 
 homologous series

 
 
• 
 A **homologous series **is made up of substances with the **same functional **group and similar **chemical properties**.
 
 
• 
 A homologous **series**' members are referred to as **homologs**.
 
 
• 
 A **-CH₂ group **distinguishes the following members of a **homologous series **from **one another.**
 
 
• 
 A** -CH₂ group** has a **molecular mass **of **14 amu.**
 
 
• 
 As a result, the mass of each succeeding **homologue **in a **homologous series **varies by **14 amu. **
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Methane (CH₄)** is followed by **ethane (C₂H₆), propane (C₃H₈), butane (C₄H₁₀),** and **pentane **(C5H12)** **in the homologous series of straight-chained **alkanes**.
 
• In that series, each new methylene bridge** (-CH₂- unit)** introduced in the chain causes the subsequent members to differ in **mass**.
 
• As a result, each member's **molecular mass **varies by **14 atomic mass units.**
 
• **"Adjacent homologues" **are members of such a series that are close to one another, such as methane and ethane.
 
• Numerous physical characteristics in that series, such as the **boiling point**, gradually alter with increasing mass.
 
• **Ethane (C₂H₆),** for instance, has a **higher boiling **point than** methane (CH₄).**

• The **small intestine **entirely **digests proteins**, **lipids**, and **carbohydrates**.

• The three parts of the small intestine are the **duodenum, jejunum, and ileum.**
 
• The substance that enters the duodenum through the **pyloric end **of the stomach is known as **chyme (acidic).**
 
• The small intestine is where **ingested macromolecules **are fully digested.
 
• The contents of the **stomach **are absorbed by the small intestine before entering the **bloodstream**.

• Different **exopeptidases **and **endopeptidases **subsequently break these polypeptides down into **amino acids**.
 
 
 
• **The rectum:**
 
 
• The **rectum's **duties include **collecting stool **from the **colon**, **alerting **you to the **presence **of **stool**, and **holding **the **stool **until **evacuation **occurs.
 
 
 
• **The large intestine:**
 
 
• **​**The **large intestine's **function is to **absorb water **and **salt **from food that hasn't been completely digested as well as to **expel **any **leftover trash**.

questions.question:
Excess demand leads to:

(A) inflationary gap.

(B) rise in employment level.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Only A.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **output **and **equilibrium **price will both shift in the same direction in response to changes in demand.
 
• A **fall **in **demand **will result in a **decrease **in a **good's equilibrium price **and **quantity**.
 
• At the original price, there is an excess supply due to the decline in demand.
 
• **Price **will **drop **due to the **oversupply**, and as a result, producers will be ready to **create less **of the **good**, **reducing output**.
 
• A **rise **in **demand **will result in an **increase **in a **good's equilibrium price **and **output**.
 
• **Excess demand **arises at the **starting price **as a result of the **growth **in **demand**.
 
• The **price **will **increase **(inflationary gap) due to excessive demand, and as the **price increases**, manufacturers will be more **inclined **to **sell**, boosting output. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Equilibrium price **and **output **will move in opposite directions as a result of a **change **in **supply**.
 
• A **decrease **in the **equilibrium **price and a **rise **in the **equilibrium quantity **of an item will result from an increase in supply.
 
• At the starting price, the **increase **in **supply **results in an **excess supply.**
 
• A **surplus **of **supply **lowers the **price **and raises the quantity sought.
 
• An **increase **in equilibrium price and a drop in the equilibrium quantity of a good will result from a decrease in supply.
 
• At the **starting price**, there is an **excess demand **due to the **decrease **in **supply**.
 
• The **price rises **and the **quantity **requested **declines **as a result of **excessive** **demand**.

• 
 As long as the light is in the water, it goes **straight**; however, if the light exits the water **obliquely **into the air, it is bent downward toward the surface.

• 
 Light accelerates once again as it leaves a **liquid **or **piece **of **glass **and **enters **the **air**.
 
 
•

• 
 This is accurate for **small **angles, however as the **angles increase**, something else occurs.
 
 
• 
 Because of this, **swimming pools **seem to get **shallower **as you approach the end that is **farthest **from you.

__
 
• **What is Mendeleev's periodic table?**

 
 
• **​****Dmitri Mendeleev** sought to establish a connection between the atomic masses of the elements and their observed chemical and physical properties.
 
• The physical and chemical properties of the elements are a periodic function of their atomic masses, according to **Mendeleev's Periodic Law**.

• **Noble gases were not listed** in Mendeleev's periodic table (since they were not found at that time), but in the modern periodic table, noble gases are located in a separate group that is designated as **group 18.**
 
• Mendeleev's periodic table **contained gaps** for undiscovered elements, whereas the present periodic table is **uniform**.
 
• In Mendeleev's periodic table, transition elements are grouped with other elements, however, in the modern periodic table, they are arranged in separate blocks.

questions.question: Which of the following is used to detect the presence of starch in food?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**Iodine solution**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iodine solution** can be added as a chemical test for **starch **to examine if it changes color from brown to blue or black. This iodine solution test allows the **separation** of starch from other **carbohydrates**.

 
 
• Example: Iodine, for instance, will cause a peeled potato to turn black.
 
 
 
• One of the main sources of **dietary energy** for people is **starch**, a type of **carbohydrate** that is frequently discovered in **nature**.
 
• Starch can be detected using a **triiodide solution**, which is created by combining iodine and an iodide solution (most commonly **potassium iodide**).
 
• This solution generates a strong **blue-black** starch-iodine combination. The triiodide solution's **brown** hue persists in the absence of starch.
 
• When triiodide anion solution is added to starch, a **charge transfer** complex between the molecules forms, which is the cause of the complex that results.
 
• It is crucial to understand that this complex formation does **not** take place in solutions containing only** iodine** or **iodide**.
 
• Therefore, an Iodine solution is used to detect the presence of starch in food*.​*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **Litmus solution**
 Blue litmus paper turns red under acidic conditions, while red litmus paper turns blue under basic or alkaline settings. This property of litmus allows it to be used as a primary indicator of the acidity or basicity of a solution.
 
 

 **Phenolphthalein**
 As an indicator in titration tests to show the titration's endpoint, phenolphthalein is a colorless, weak acid that is frequently utilized.
 
 

 **Benedict's solution**
 This chemical solution, which is employed in clinical urine testing for diabetes, changes color with the presence of glucose and other reducing sugars. It consists of a combination of copper sulfate, sodium or potassium citrate, and sodium carbonate.
